label: Possibly a necessary being, from B1 and B2 in sense BEGINS_2
meaning: Discloses what B1 and B2 in sense BEGINS_2 already carry, with no frame condition: causal opportunity applied to the possible beginning yields an accessible history v with an existing concrete individual distinct from every contingent concrete individual of v; under rigid identity and classical accessibility it is absent from no world accessible from v (ExternalCandidateNecessity), so possibly a necessary concrete individual exists (d2d7cf61). A rival who denies that a necessary concrete individual is possible therefore rejects B2 in this sense (given B1) outright; the arrival does not discriminate against that rival, as noted for the parameter-sense B2 and for A3 prime a with A3 prime b. Both premises are OPEN. No premise is established.
